title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
summary: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.
title_es: OpenAI adquiere Orchestra Bio para impulsar IA en investigación biomédica
bajada: OpenAI compró Orchestra Bio para fortalecer Rosalind, su modelo de IA especializado en ciencias de la vida. La adquisición busca acelerar el desarrollo de fármacos y ayudar a equipos de biopharma en la planificación de experimentos y análisis de resultados.
bajada_en: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio to strengthen Rosalind, its AI model specialized in life sciences. The acquisition aims to accelerate drug development and help biopharma teams with experiment planning and result analysis.

title_es: El negocio de IA de SpaceX supera expectativas con ganancia de $4.4B
bajada: SpaceX alcanzó rentabilidad en Q3 con ingresos netos de $4.4 mil millones, impulsado principalmente por su división de IA (Superintelligencia). La unidad incluye X, Grok y un servicio de infraestructura en nube que ya ofrece a clientes externos.
bajada_en: SpaceX reached profitability in Q3 with $4.4 billion net income, driven primarily by its AI (Superintelligence) division. The unit includes X, Grok and a cloud infrastructure service already offered to external customers.

title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.
title_es: SpaceX examina posible fusión con Tesla y expande negocio de nube
bajada: Musk informó a accionistas de SpaceX sobre la posible fusión con Tesla y destacó el crecimiento explosivo de la división de SI (Superintelligencia). El negocio de infraestructura en nube de SpaceX ya ofrece servicios a Anthropic y otros clientes externos.
bajada_en: Musk informed SpaceX shareholders about potential Tesla merger and highlighted explosive growth in the SI (Superintelligence) division. SpaceX's cloud infrastructure business already serves Anthropic and other external customers.

title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
title_es: Anthropic propone regulación de IA que bloquearía modelos con riesgo alto
bajada: Anthropic presentó una propuesta de ley que podría bloquear el lanzamiento de modelos de IA si existe riesgo de que causen muertes. Aunque busca protección contra riesgos, la propuesta requeriría autorización judicial para que agencias federales bloqueen un modelo.
bajada_en: Anthropic proposed an AI safety bill that could block model releases if they pose risk of deaths. While seeking protection against risks, the proposal would require judicial approval for federal agencies to block a model.

title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
summary: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.
title_es: Claude diseñó proteínas contra neurotoxinas de escorpión
bajada: Investigadores de Anthropic lograron que Claude diseñara binders de proteína contra neurotoxinas de escorpión. El resultado demuestra capacidad de modelos de lenguaje avanzados para contribuir a descubrimientos científicos reales en biología molecular.
bajada_en: Anthropic researchers got Claude to design protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins. The result demonstrates advanced language models' ability to contribute to real scientific discoveries in molecular biology.

bajada: Meta pausó la función de compartir en Muse luego de que investigadores encontraran más de 6,800 URLs de conversaciones públicamente accesibles en registros DNS. El incidente expone un problema de seguridad en la gestión de privacidad del asistente de IA.

title_es: Nvidia invierte cientos de millones en proveedor de nube Firmus
bajada: Nvidia negocia una inversión de cientos de millones en Firmus, proveedor australiano de infraestructura en nube para IA, después que canceló su IPO. El movimiento refleja la apuesta de Nvidia en respaldar empresas neocloud en dificultades financieras.
bajada_en: Nvidia negotiates a hundreds-of-millions investment in Firmus, an Australian AI cloud infrastructure provider, after its IPO was pulled. The move reflects Nvidia's bet on backing financially troubled neocloud companies.

title: Nvidia Moves to Back GPU Cloud Provider Firmus After Investors Balk at Its IPO
summary: Nvidia is in talks to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in Australian AI cloud provider Firmus, which abruptly pulled its initial public offering early this month, according to people familiar with the talks.The discussion indicates that Nvidia is likely to continue backing a group of unproven firms known as neoclouds that is facing financial pressure after they stacked up on debt to purchase Nvidia graphics processing units for data centers. Nvidia has already put more than $170 billion on the line for such firms and other large customers, including credit guarantees to help them raise the debt,according to The Information’s analysis.
title_es: Anthropic enfrenta dificultades para asegurar capacidad de cómputo
bajada: Anthropic lucha por acceso suficiente a computación en proveedores cloud que la ven como competidora, mientras su gasto en infraestructura se dispara antes de su IPO de noviembre. La tensión refleja conflictos de interés entre fabricantes de infraestructura y startups de IA.
bajada_en: Anthropic struggles to secure enough compute from cloud providers that view it as a competitor, as infrastructure spending balloons before November IPO. The tension reflects conflicts of interest between infrastructure vendors and AI startups.

title: SpaceX’s Musk Lauds Its Soaring Cloud Business and Possible Tesla Merger
summary: SpaceX put on a bit of a show for shareholders today—and I’m not referring to the sizzle reel of rocket and space videos it showed on its earnings call. No, the big attention grabber was the update from CEO Elon Musk on the progress of SpaceX’s contemplated merger with Tesla and just how involved—or not involved he is in the whole affair.First though, it’s worth mentioning the other big highlight from the call: SpaceX’s booming AI—excuse me, SI—business, a category that includes the company’s X social media service, its Grok Bot agent platform and a cloud infrastructure service it has started to rent to outsiders like Anthropic. The segment is on fire. It saw its third-quarter revenue nearly triple to $7.56 billion, making it the largest business category at SpaceX. And if that wasn’t enough, the SI business swung to an operating profit of $431 million from a $1.26 billion loss in the second quarter.SpaceX shares jumped nearly 7% in after-hours trading following the report.SpaceX executives made it clear that the big story in its SI (superintelligence) segment is its cloud business. Musk told investors the company’s phone is ringing off the hook with demand from businesses that want to lease SpaceX’s AI compute. “We are hounded relentlessly by every hyperscaler and by dozens of smaller companies to rent more of our compute,” Musk said. “We could rent out our compute several times over if we said yes to everyone.”For his part, Bret Johnsen, SpaceX’s chief financial officer, described that demand as “extraordinary” and said at the prices it’s currently charging its cloud customers, SpaceX is “generating a payback in less than a year” on new data centers after it deploys them.Musk also addressed a question from an investor about his desire to unite SpaceX and Tesla. title_es: Spotify eliminó 50 millones de canciones AI slop de recomendaciones
bajada: Spotify removió más de 50 millones de temas considerados AI slop o spam de su sistema de recomendaciones en el último año. La plataforma también modificó su algoritmo para priorizar música de artistas humanos, enfrentando la saturación de contenido generado automáticamente.
bajada_en: Spotify removed over 50 million AI-generated slop and spam tracks from recommendations over the past year. The platform also modified its algorithm to prioritize music from human artists, tackling automated content saturation.
